designationHistory.name: Lostwood Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Lostwood Migratory Waterfowl Refuge, about 33,045 acres in Burke and Mountrail Counties, North Dakota, by Executive Order 7171.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Lostwood National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.
